code.description: The code-name, unique for the tenant.

feeType.description: 'PERCENT' for relative values, 'ABSOLUTE' for float values or 'ABSOLUTE_MULTIPLY_ITEMQUANTITY' for float values to be multiplied by the quantity of the item.

feePercentage.description: The fee rate in percentage. Required if feeType is 'PERCENT'.

feeAbsolute.description: The fee as an absolute amount. Required if type is 'ABSOLUTE'.

itemType.description:
The itemtype the fee can belong to. It could be a product or
paymenttype.

siteCode.description: The SiteCode the fee belongs to.

active.description: Flag indicating whether the fee is currently active or not.

taxable.description: Flag indicating whether the fee is taxable or not.

taxCode.description: The tax code. When 'taxable' is set to true, the taxCode is mandatory

Localized.description: The localized value in the form of map (language, value) or string.

oneOf.description:
Map of translations in form of language:translation pairs.
The keys (languages) should be ISO language codes.
The values (in specific languages) should be strings in specified language.

YRN.title: YRN
YRN.description: A unique identifier of a global resource, which stores information about the resource, such as its type, ID or name of the tenant.

monetaryAmount.title: Monetary Amount
monetaryAmount.description: Schema defining monetary amount in given currency.

amount.description: The amount in the specified currency

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g.: USD, EUR, CHF

timespan.description:
Restricts the active fees to be only applied in the specified
timespan.
timespan.title: Timespan
